Game Overview

In Dog Escape, the core idea is straightforward: leap into the paws of a savvy pup in Dog Escape, dodging the persistent dogcatcher while snatching bones in timed, action-packed levels. Hone your reflexes and strategy as obstacles grow trickier, racing against the clock to outsmart and outpace your relentless pursuer. Can you prove to be the ultimate elusive pooch?

Playing Dog Escape comes down to a simple loop. Leap into the paws of a savvy pup in Dog Escape, dodging the persistent dogcatcher while snatching bones in timed, action-packed levels.
